title: Where Harris's father learned: Professor Holmes in Lutcher
summary: Harris thinks his father learned from Professor Holmes in Lutcher, who taught all the country musicians.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Do you know, did your father ever tell you where he learned or when he learned and who's, if he had a teacher or anything about his early days? No, he did.

I think he learned in Lutche, Louisiana on the, I think it was Professor Holmes. Professor Holmes. Professor Holmes up there in Lutche. In Lutche, yes. Well, he was teaching all the musicians. A little country town in there, he was teaching all the musicians. He's still there? No, he's dead now. Oh, Professor Holmes. My father's dead too.
